name: Kateinai Koubi
source:
The first game to come from the Pregnancy series!
A child making full-length novel game that straddles all generations.
From a peaceful everyday life, slowly reiterating down to hit rock bottom...
What awaits these girls when they reach the end?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036920.html]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
「懷孕」系列的第一部遊戲！這是一部長篇視覺小說，以跨越不同世代的生育故事為主線。

從平靜的日常起步，生活卻一點點滑落，直至跌入谷底……道路盡頭，等待這些女孩的究竟是什麼？

［摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036920.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
